title: Speak
subtitle: Main console for composing, repeating, and quick-firing voice.

virtualMic.tooltip: Sends the voice as a virtual microphone to Discord, Zoom, and games
virtualMic.banner: The generated audio will be sent to the virtual microphone. Select "CABLE Output" as the microphone in Discord, Zoom, or games.

export.label: Export history as CSV
export.emptyMessage: There are no phrases in the history to export.

speed.title: Speed
speed.note: Online voices come from Microsoft Edge TTS. They work instantly, with no installation, but need internet.

input.placeholder: > type a phrase. Enter sends. Shift+Enter for a new line.
input.savePhraseAria: Save current phrase as a quick shortcut

shortcuts.title: Quick shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Write the phrase, click Create shortcut, and trigger it with the key anywhere (Discord, game).
shortcuts.placeholder: What should the shortcut say? (e.g. GG, great match!)
shortcuts.empty: No shortcuts yet. Create the first one above.

toasts.onlineFailed: Could not generate the online voice.
toasts.micNotRouted: Voice not on the virtual microphone
toasts.micNotRoutedMessage: The voice played on the speaker ({{reason}}) — Discord didn't hear it.
toasts.chooseOnlineMessage: Select a voice from the Edge TTS list before speaking.
toasts.noVoiceMessage: {{label}}. Install Piper (50 MB) to speak offline.
toasts.permissionDeniedMessage: Without it the app can't see device names or find CABLE Input. Allow access and try again.
toasts.chooseOutputMessage: Open Settings > Virtual microphone and select CABLE Input so Discord hears the online voice.
toasts.micNotFoundMessage: It comes with the app installer. If you just installed it, restart Windows.
